profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Technology is always evolving and improving people's quality of life. That's why it's hard to see those use manual processes that can take up precious time from the day. I love to automate processes for people so that that one less thing they have to worry allowing them to focus on more important things. To sum up the technologies I work with currently it would be AWS for cloud resources, Terraform to represent infrastructure and modules and code, and various programming languages such as Python, Golang, Powershell, Bash, etc. Personally I driven and motivates as long as I know the benefits, outcome, and what next.

Additionally, I'm in the Air National Guard performing Cyber Operations. This involves hunting through ELK stack or a related Security Information and Event Management Tool to search for malicious activity and provide a timeline of events to the affected party.

positions.title: Cyber Warefare Operator
positions.description: - Automated the process of setting up case tasks in DIFR IRIS by creating a python script to extract DFIR IRIS existing tasks and format them in task template json format.
positions.insights: Skills: Active DoD Top Secret Clearance

positions.title: Principal Cybersecurity Infrastructure Engineer (Devops)
positions.description:
- Repaired a SOC’s Elasticsearch cluster by splitting the cluster into dedicated master and data/ingest nodes. Furthermore, enabled metric collection to improve performance and identify problem areas such as building a lifecycle policy, allocating the correct amount of storage and memory per node to avoid allocation and out-of-memory errors.
- Assisted with the migration from a Digital Ocean ELK stack cluster to Wazuh Cloud reducing infrastructure maintenance and allowing SOC analyst to focus on incident response and alerting.
- Managed two Kubernetes clusters, an AKS cluster and a RKE2 on-premise cluster, and improved cluster management by automating the deployment of application using helm charts with Helmfile and Gitlab CI, building custom helm charts, and creating an ansible script to perform RKE2 updates for an air gapped environment.
- Managed a six node VMware cluster and implemented DRS and Virtual Machine templates to increase availability of virtual machines and standardize virtual machines deployments to use Rocky Linux.
- Improved the build and deploy process of a React and Django application by fixing Dockerfiles and deploying through Github Actions.
- Modernized the on-boarding process by building a python flask application to automate the creation of user accounts and emailing on-boarding information.

positions.title: Associate DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
• Used C# to build a printing tool that integrated with our custom company’s shipping page in turn increasing our gross margin and reducing the time it takes to get customer products ready to ship by 30%.

• Used Golang, AWS (Eventbridge and ECS) and Terraform to automate the process of creating state compliance reports for nurse practitioners to ensure the quality assurance team could ensure 100% compliance.

• Created CI/CD pipelines using Github Actions, Terraform, Docker, and Ansible to manage the state of our on-premise (VMware) and AWS  infrastructure.

• Improved developer productivity by creating and managing Github Action CI/CD pipelines and reducing the time it took to test, build, and deploy code from development to production.

positions.title: Senior System Administrator
positions.description:
• Built a tool with Powershell and Python that automatically updates all employees’ profiles with the appropriate name, department, position, and direct reports based on our human resources system reducing the employees to send request update information.

• Created a tool in python that allowed our pharmacy frontend to communicate with our company’s backend using REST API on customer’s order and payment information.

• Created an Ansible playbook to automate Linux and Windows infrastructure patching on a monthly cadence during our maintenance hours.

• Managed a two 3-Node Cisco Hyperflex Cluster networked through using Meraki Networking Equipment (MX and MS)

• Managed Windows workstations using Active Directory and Ninja RMM and MacOS workstations using JAMF/Kandji

positions.title: Desktop Support Analyst
positions.description:
•	Managed local area networks and IT systems, and solved 500+ network problems; resulted in a 98% readiness rating
•	Installed and managed Blackberry Unified Enterprise Manager to 29 iPhone providing 24/7 email and Air Force Virtual Private Network access
•	Executed information assurance risk and vulnerability assessments, identified system weaknesses, and took corrective actions to mitigate risk
•	Drafted PowerShell scripts to automate repetitive tasks to include manual patching and acquiring information from multiple systems

positions.title: IT Support Specialist
positions.description:
•	Installed, diagnosed, upgraded, replaced, configured, maintained, and repaired software issues for operating systems
•	Managed network user accounts, computer account, and troubleshot multiple end devices supporting the $81M local area network infrastructure and resources 
•	Oversaw iPhone program worth $104K by standardizing phones and providing 24/7 email access worldwide for 343 personnel 
•	Responded to classified and unclassified trouble tickets; maintained system operability during upgrade of systems during tech refresh

positions.title: IT Support Specialist
positions.description:
•	Supervised 10 personnel in a communications expansion project to install 30 critical systems
•	Managed 60K+ user and computer accounts for multiple networks using Active Directory and NET IQ’s Directory and Repository Administration web application
•	Ensured secure and non-secure voice, data, and video communication services to various Department of Defense objectives
•	Performed system hardware and software operations, installations, configuration, and troubleshooting for $24M network supporting 11K+ customers
